sources.snippet: AlignTune is a production-ready fine-tuning library designed to simplify training and fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs) with both Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods. It provides a high-level, unified API that abstracts away the complexities of backend selection, algorithm configuration, and training loops, letting you focus on delivering results.
